images.title: A cone unrolls into a sector
images.purpose: Shows a cone of base radius 5 cm and slant length 10 cm unrolling into a semicircle of radius 10 cm.
images.composition: Plain white background with generous empty margins; the main object is large and centred and fills about 60 percent of the frame; nothing else is drawn. Before and after in one row: the cone on the left, a thick grey arrow, the flat semicircle on the right.
images.exact_structure: Left: an upright cone, apex at the top, drawn flat with a thin dark outline, curved surface filled teal #0072B2, the base drawn as an ellipse outline. A reddish purple #CC79A7 slant line from the apex down the front to the rim, labelled '10 cm'. A thin grey radius line on the base labelled '5 cm'. The apex labelled 'O'. Centre: a thick grey arrow pointing right. Right: a semicircle of radius 10 units filled teal, with its straight edge horizontal at the bottom and its centre marked with a dot labelled 'O'. One radius from O drawn in reddish purple labelled '10 cm'. The curved arc drawn thicker in amber #E69F00 and labelled '10π cm'. Under the semicircle: 'half circle'. So '10 cm' appears twice and 'O' twice. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The cone opens into part of a circle centred at its tip; here the arc 10π cm is half of 20π cm.
images.description: Shows a cone of base radius 5 cm and slant length 10 cm unrolling into a semicircle of radius 10 cm.
images.context: Concept T8.C3; one image that shows only the main idea.
images.teaching_notes: Arc = base circumference 2 × π × 5 = 10π; full circle of radius 10 has 20π; fraction 1/2.

image_decisions.why: Unrolling a surface is a change of shape that has to be seen; before and after shows it directly.
